metadata.name: CatacombGL
metadata.summary: Source port of the classic Catacomb 3D and Catacomb Adventure games featuring hardware-accelerated OpenGL graphics

content.value: CatacombGL is an open-source port of the early first-person fantasy games Catacomb 3-D and the Catacomb Adventure series, originally developed by id Software and Softdisk. Built using SDL and OpenGL, it upgrades the classic 16-color, 320x200 MS-DOS titles with modern hardware acceleration and visual enhancements while preserving authentic gameplay.

The engine requires original game assets from either the shareware release of The Catacomb Abyss or the commercial Catacombs Pack, providing an integrated launcher to select and manage compatible titles.

items.value: Hardware-accelerated 3D rendering with OpenGL, widescreen resolutions, and an uncapped frame rate
Customizable field of view and configurable mouse and keyboard controls
Smooth player, monster, and projectile movement with floating-point precision
Built-in game selection menu with auto-detection for installed game data
Full compatibility with Catacomb 3-D, The Catacomb Abyss, The Catacomb Armageddon, and The Catacomb Apocalypse
